svg.text: coldchain-copilot: the entities, and the code that reads them
definitions: object types, classes, links, event and action types
contract and SOP articles as rules
reefer, cargo class, contract, policy, period
one reading per reefer per minute
one chunk per article, with its embedding
The engine reads names from the ontology and asks the registry for the functions; the agent reaches data only through the gateway.
